AHCINT 1.3.0.0-usos2 - MODIFIED version of AHCINT 1.3.0.0 (ages2001,
https://github.com/ages2001/AHCINT, tag v1.3.0.0 = commit 7be9c9b8), changed
by the USOS project on 2026-09-30 (usos1) and 2026-10-03 (usos2). Not an
upstream release. Licence: GPL-3.0, as the original (LICENSE).

usos1 (patches/0001-usos1-flush-cache.patch):
- SYNCHRONIZE CACHE (10)/(16), SRB_FUNCTION_FLUSH and SRB_FUNCTION_SHUTDOWN
  send FLUSH CACHE (E7h) or FLUSH CACHE EXT (EAh) to the drive; FUA writes
  are followed by a flush; MODE SENSE returns the caching page (WCE from
  IDENTIFY word 85).

usos2 (patches/0002-usos2-target-check-and-trace.patch), after the first X470
run, where text-mode Setup copied files but nothing reached the disk:
- Before every command the port must have a link (SSTS.DET = 3) and a
  running command engine (PxCMD ST, FRE, CR, FR); otherwise the port is
  restarted once and the command fails instead of being issued.
- Counters (reads, writes, sectors written, errors, PRD byte count
  mismatches, engine restarts, flushes); a PRD byte count that does not
  match the request is counted.
- The USOS gap: on the one disk whose LBA 2046 holds the USOS marker
  ("USOSW2KTRACE", written by tools/w2k_stage.sh usos_w2k_gap_marker), the
  driver writes and reads back a test pattern at LBA 2045 at every start; a
  mismatch hides the port from Setup ("no hard disk" instead of copying
  into nothing). It increments the boot counter in the marker and writes an
  ASCII trace (counters, every port's SSTS/CMD/SIG/TFD and model) to LBA
  2040 + boot % 4, again after every flush. Other disks are only read at LBA
  2046.

Every changed spot in src/ is marked "MODIFIED (USOS 1.3.0.0-usosN)".
Built with WDK 7.1 (build.cmd, x86 WXP target); every import (12: ntoskrnl,
scsiport) resolves on the Windows 2000 SP4 kernel and scsiport.
